pairs.advice: the pair trades wider than the round-trip toll on almost every session: this is a standing condition, so the swap is a permanent re-tickering and there is nothing to watch between decision bars
the pair trades wider than the round-trip toll on almost every session: this is a standing condition, so the swap is a permanent re-tickering and there is nothing to watch between decision bars
the gap does not clear the round-trip toll: swapping would pay more to move than it saves, so the trigger is the gap itself (re-read on the next decision bar)

swap_trigger.recheck_rule: any bar inside the grid works: the gap is not a perishable tail (one-off part 6,845 CNY). After execution the only number that can bring the decision back is the round-trip toll: re-read this face on the next decision bar, and act again only if a pair's gap exceeds 0.16 pp (2 x 8 bp per side).
caveats: the trigger is priced in pp of notional and compared against the round-trip cost only; it does not price tracking difference, fee, size or FX-hedge policy between the two tickers
episode lengths are measured on the reconstructed gap, which inherits the single IOPV anchor of the gap face; censored episodes are reported, never scored as zero
a 'window always open' reading means the pair is structurally wide, not that the swap has to be repeated: the book only has to hold it once

swap_toll.sentence: 这次换票已经付了 ¥251 的过路费（每一对卖出+买入各 8bp），如果下一个决策 bar 换回来，同样的钱还要再付一遍 ¥251——往返合计 ¥502 = 0.32pp；占今天价差 3.7%/5.1%、占各自平均价差 15.5%/14.5%。
caveats: the exit toll is contingent: a standing gap (WINDOW_ALWAYS_OPEN) means the desk may never trade back, so the second exchange is a price on a decision, not a charge already incurred
both halves are priced on the same close and the same notional: intraday execution moves the proceeds and the lots, and a re-widened gap moves the notional, not the bp
fees and tracking difference between the two tickers are not modelled; cost_bp_per_side is the trigger's own constant, imported here rather than restated

swap_convergence.sentence: 换回来的收益是量出来的、不是假设价不变：159501（宽于均值 档 272 例）20 个交易日后价差中位变化 +0.15 pp，扣掉四边 0.32 pp 后净 -0.4705 pp；513100（宽于均值 档 377 例）20 个交易日后价差中位变化 -0.09 pp，扣掉四边 0.32 pp 后净 -0.2265 pp。按实际换出的 ¥156,947 算，合计净 -¥547。
caveats: this measures the pair's relative price path after a wide session; it is not a book backtest -- nothing else in the book moves, no other name is re-ranked inside the horizon, and the decision to exchange back is assumed to be taken exactly at the horizon

the cheap ticker is bought with the same money, so the harvest is a better entry into the same basket rather than a realised capital gain; the pp below is what the pair hands back, which is the number that decides whether a second exchange pays for its own four sides
a cohort member whose forward window runs past the end of the panel is censored, not treated as a zero change (r1230 r0)
the reconstruction inherits the sibling-gap face's single IOPV anchor; a premium base that shifted between the two tickers would move the level, not the change

swap_units.sentence: 折扣是份数不是钱：159501 换出的 ¥78,492.00 在 159513 的 ¥1.76 上多买到 3,188.92 份（31 手 + 88.92 份零头）；513100 换出的 ¥78,455.00 在 159513 的 ¥1.76 上多买到 2,357.56 份（23 手 + 57.56 份零头），合计 **5,546.48 份 = 55 手 + 46.48 份**（误差上限 ±27.73 份 = 换入票溢价材料线 0.5 pp）。这 5,546.48 份就在账本那笔 159513 手里（891 手 = 89,100 份，占 6.22%），是它的一个子集、不是第二笔持仓；下一根 bar 还没产生（日历上的下一交易日 2026-11-11），届时用**同一份数**乘当日价重估；在交易日这根上「份数×当日价」恒等于折扣本身，印出来只是恒等式。下一个决策 bar（每 20 根）读作 2026-12-08。
swap_units.not_realised: 折扣是「同一笔钱多买到多少份」，不是卖掉的那部分收入的差——它只有在这些份被卖出、且价差已经收窄时才变成现金；在那之前把它记成已实现收益，等于把份额当成钱。
swap_units.not_repriced: 份数在买入那一刻就固定了；下一根 bar 能改的只有它按什么价重估。用新的价差重算折扣＝把 r1523 的路径栏再做一遍，本面不提供这个数。
caveats: the level column is r1524's own figure (already re-scaled on the trimmed book); it is divided by the price this book actually paid, never re-derived from a gap

shares carry a bounded error of at most the sibling's premium (the bound is the premium materiality line, printed beside the count): a NAV-caliber CNY divided by a market price is not exactly a share count
a lot is the smallest thing a ticket can trade, so the discount is only realisable in whole lots; the residue shares are named and priced apart
the size is a subset of the position the ledger holds; it is not a second holding and it is not added to NAV
